# Mélange Digital

> Mélange Digital is a destination and travel marketing agency that helps national tourism boards, DMOs, NTOs and travel brands win Indian travellers. It turns cultural insight into measurable arrivals and bookings through creator and celebrity campaigns, branded content and IP integrations, experiential marketing, and FAM trips and travel PR.

Key facts:
- Founded: 2021
- Founder and CEO: Sanket Bolinjkar
- Headquarters: Goa, India
- Global presence: India, United Arab Emirates, Singapore, United Kingdom, Zambia
- Leadership experience: 15+ years combined
- Clients: 10+ national tourism boards and travel brands, including Singapore Tourism Board, Hong Kong Tourism Board, Saudi Tourism Authority, South African Tourism, Tourism Australia, Zambia Tourism Authority, Visit Brussels, Resorts World Sentosa, Costa Cruises and Norwegian Cruise Line
- Creator network: 5,000+ creators and celebrities across Bollywood, regional cinema, OTT, music, cricket, comedy, food and travel
- Focus market: India outbound travel, covering metros and Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities, plus GCC campaigns
- Awards: India Business Awards 2025 (Most Impactful Full-Service Marketing Agency); Asia Leadership Award 2024 (Best Use of AI in Marketing); Brand Impact Award 2024
- Contact: hello@melangedigital.co, +91 93725 67722

## Company
- [Homepage](https://melangedigital.co/): Travel and tourism marketing agency for tourism boards targeting Indian travellers, with campaign outcomes, client roster and method.
- [About](https://melangedigital.co/about): Agency story since 2021, leadership team, vision and global presence.
- [Services](https://melangedigital.co/services): Overview of destination marketing services for tourism boards and travel brands.
- [Influencer & Celebrity Marketing](https://melangedigital.co/services/influencer-marketing): Creator and celebrity campaigns cast by subculture fit, including regional-language creators across India.
- [Branded Content & IPs](https://melangedigital.co/services/branded-content-ips): Destination integrations in films, music videos, OTT and editorial properties.
- [Experiential Marketing](https://melangedigital.co/services/experiential-marketing): Trade shows such as OTM Mumbai, roadshows, mall activations and destination launches.
- [FAM Trips + PR](https://melangedigital.co/services/fam-trips-pr): Familiarisation trips, journalist and creator hosting, destination PR and travel trade engagement.
- [Contact](https://melangedigital.co/contact): Contact the team and book a strategy call.

## Case Studies
- [Singapore Tourism Board: #IsThisEvenSingapore](https://melangedigital.co/work/singapore-tourism-board-isthisevensingapore): 21 creators across five youth subcultures delivered 190M views; total Indian arrivals grew 18% YoY and the under-35 traveller share rose from 31% to 39%.
- [Hong Kong Tourism Board: #HerHongKong](https://melangedigital.co/work/hong-kong-tourism-board-herhongkong): Repositioned Hong Kong for independent South Indian women travellers; +22% YoY growth in South Indian female arrivals and average stay up from 2 to 3 nights.
- [Zambia Tourism: OTM Mumbai 2026](https://melangedigital.co/work/zambia-tourism-otm-mumbai-2026): Debut trade-show presence that won Most Promising Destination; client-reported 500+ trade connections and about $3.2M from seven MICE groups over a one-year mandate.
- [Resorts World Sentosa: Go Bananas in Minion Land](https://melangedigital.co/work/resorts-world-sentosa-go-bananas-in-minion-land): Regional-language creator campaign on ShareChat and Moj across 15 states; 86M+ views and 4,927 tracked direct bookings.
- [Dream Cruises (ran as Resorts World Cruises): Premium Cruise Launch, Dubai](https://melangedigital.co/work/resorts-world-cruises-premium-cruise-launch-dubai): Maiden GCC cruise launch with 44 creators; $2.3M+ attributed sales, 90M+ impressions and 250K+ clicks.
- [Costa Cruises: Introducing Luxury Cruising to India](https://melangedigital.co/work/costa-cruises-introducing-luxury-cruising-to-india): Maiden Italy-to-India voyage launch in a market with no cruise category awareness; 9,000+ qualified enquiries.
- [Saudi Tourism: Mall Activation](https://melangedigital.co/work/mall-activation-for-saudi-tourism): Mall kiosk activation repositioning Saudi Arabia from a religious to a leisure destination for Indian travellers; 400+ walk-ins and 1,200+ e-visa enquiries in four days.
- [Dharma Productions x Singapore Tourism Board: Jigra](https://melangedigital.co/work/dharma-productions-x-singapore-tourism-board-jigra): Bollywood film integration to position Singapore as South Asia's premier filming destination.
- [Singapore Tourism Board x DIVINE: Saucy Music Video](https://melangedigital.co/work/singapore-tourism-board-x-divine-saucy-music-video): Singapore integrated into a hip-hop music video to reach under-35 Indian travellers who ignore destination advertising.
- [Hong Kong Tourism Board x Ram Charan: Esquire India Cover](https://melangedigital.co/work/hong-kong-tourism-board-x-ram-charan-esquire-india-cover): Celebrity editorial cover positioning Hong Kong as a luxury leisure destination for South Indian audiences.
- [All case studies](https://melangedigital.co/work): Full work portfolio.
